highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
highlights_body: This line improves reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clipping and displacement precision. HarfBuzzSharp adds named script constants, while the shared hash-code polyfill switches to OS-generated randomness for its per-process seed.

bullets.lead: Skia m158 with unchanged SkiaSharp managed signatures
bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 and incorporates subsequent same-milestone native fixes. The engine transition preserves SkiaSharp's managed binding surface.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz 15 and complete named script coverage
bullets.detail: Upgrades native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 HarfBuzzSharp Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. The existing 149 values, struct-based API, parsing, numeric conversions and direction lookup are preserved; no public managed member is removed.

bullets.lead: GPU hairlines and text-atlas selection are corrected
bullets.detail: Reflected transforms no longer enlarge square caps on zero-length hairlines. Ganesh rounds interpolated atlas indices before selecting ordinary and LCD text samplers, avoiding the wrong atlas when interpolation is imprecise.

bullets.lead: Graphite clips and displacement sampling respect their bounds
bullets.detail: Pass-capacity checks account for undrawn clip elements; draws whose clip stacks cannot fit a fresh pass are logged and rejected. Displacement scale and offset arithmetic use full precision to agree with filter bounds, while channel samples remain half precision.

bullets.lead: Vulkan wait handling and affected-device teardown improve
bullets.detail: Failed synchronous fence waits now affect native Ganesh submission results, but GRContext.Submit remains void. Ganesh and Graphite delay device-loss cleanup by 1 ms only on affected ARM proprietary drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56; ordinary successful submissions are not delayed.

The shared hash-code polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now uses RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random for its per-process seed. Hashes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now initializes cryptographic randomness.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared hash-code polyfill's seed with OS-generated randomness and added analyzer safeguards against unjustified System.Random use in shipped code.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17: Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and propagates failed synchronous Vulkan waits into native submission results without changing the void managed Submit API. The shared hash-code polyfill now seeds itself with OS-generated randomness while keeping hashes stable within a process.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Preview 2 updates HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants. GPU fixes cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip capacity and device-loss cleanup timing on affected ARM Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while retaining all existing values and the struct-based API. Removing the unused internal deprecated font-face setter import does not remove a public managed member.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine with unchanged managed bindings.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script constants. Rendering corrections cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM drivers.

v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.headline: Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling.
v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.body: The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated randomness while remaining stable within a process. Managed API signatures are unchanged.
